[EN] Whatever you do, don't get lost out there—you might not get back. I feel like I'm lucky to have lasted this long.

Or maybe just careful.
[ES] Hagas lo que hagas, no te pierdas por ahí; tal vez no logres regresar. Siento que tengo suerte de haber durado tanto.

O tal vez solo soy cuidadoso.
